assumptions.statement: SITE-001 is derived from the repository-maintained provisional rough boundary and is not an official planning boundary.
assumptions.impact: All design geometry, area calculations, maps, figures, and phasing support conceptual review only and must be rebuilt when an official polygon is supplied.
assumptions.next_action: Replace only from a rights-cleared official CAD/GIS/PDF source with documented CRS and conversion method.

assumptions.statement: PROV-KEY-001 through PROV-KEY-003 are provisional placeholders constrained by announced sequence and area, not surveyed key-area polygons.
assumptions.impact: Detailed-design layouts, building prototypes, neighbor stations, road links, public spaces, and key-area metrics remain directional.
assumptions.next_action: Rebuild all three key-area designs after official polygons and site-survey constraints are available.

assumptions.statement: Issue #846 reports an approximately 412.5 metre background difference between the repository provisional overall range and an OSM-mapped heritage-park trace.
assumptions.impact: The OSM trace is background only and cannot move, validate, or replace the submitted provisional boundary.
assumptions.next_action: Resolve the discrepancy only against organizer-issued or otherwise rights-cleared official geometry.

assumptions.statement: Issue #1029 reports that PROV-KEY-003 is approximately 2.26 kilometres from the Dazhongsi station name anchor and currently preserves sequence and announced area rather than station anchoring.
assumptions.impact: No station-city integration, four-quadrant connection, access route, or facility location is represented as surveyed or approved.
assumptions.next_action: Confirm the official Dazhongsi key-area polygon and transport interfaces before spatial deepening.

assumptions.statement: Official floor-area ratio, building height, building coverage, setback, green-ratio, parcel, and other regulatory controls are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: The proposal does not state statutory development intensity; conceptual land use and prototype footprints cannot be used for planning permission.
assumptions.next_action: Confirm all controls from approved regulatory planning conditions and specialist constraints.

assumptions.statement: Current building footprints, structure, ownership, occupancy, heritage status, and retain-renovate-demolish conditions are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: BLDG-* features are removable conceptual prototypes and do not identify existing buildings or demolition decisions.
assumptions.next_action: Complete survey, ownership, structural, heritage, fire, and stakeholder review before building-level decisions.

assumptions.statement: Road redlines, intersection geometry, rail interfaces, bridges, tunnels, parking, loading, and verified accessibility conditions are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: ROAD-* features are conceptual walking and cycling centerlines and do not establish rights of way or approved traffic organization.
assumptions.next_action: Undertake transport, accessibility, safety, and field surveys with responsible authorities and operators.

assumptions.statement: Municipal utilities, flood-control, drainage, fire access, energy capacity, heritage controls, and construction conditions are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Blue-green, rain-garden, edge-computing, energy, and permanent-facility proposals remain principles rather than engineering conclusions.
assumptions.next_action: Complete municipal, water, fire, energy, heritage, and engineering coordination before permanent works.

assumptions.statement: No government implementation commitment, operator appointment, budget, event approval, procurement path, or long-term funding is assumed.
assumptions.impact: Programs, the Jing-Zhang New Neighbors Week, service counters, sandboxes, and public-benefit contracts are conceptual recommendations with evidence gates and exit conditions.
assumptions.next_action: Confirm accountable operators, paid labour terms, data governance, public participation, approvals, budgets, maintenance, and exit duties before pilots.

assumptions.statement: Issue #1062 is open and the general Git-blob manifest fix in PR #1064 was not merged into upstream/main@d7459c5c when the scaffold was created.
assumptions.impact: Windows CRLF/LF conversion can make locally calculated manifest hashes differ from committed Git blobs even when content is unchanged.
assumptions.next_action: Keep repository-local core.autocrlf=false, normalize final text deliberately, and compare manifest SHA-256 values with an isolated temporary Git index before commit.
